display_long_description:
Become a fire fighter and answer the call in I Am Fire Fighter, fire rescue, emergency response, and action-packed rescue missions.

Step into dangerous fire emergencies, enter burning locations, fight spreading flames, rescue trapped civilians, and complete challenging fire fighter missions. Use fire fighter tools and firefighting equipment to control each fire, clear obstacles, and reach people in danger.

Take on 15 fire fighter rescue missions with civilian rescue, emergency rescue, first responder objectives, and firefighting challenges. Start with fire fighter training in the tutorial, then face tougher fire emergencies as you progress.

KEY FEATURES
• 15 fire fighter and fire rescue missions
• Immersive fire fighter simulator gameplay
• Fire fighter tools and firefighting equipment
• Fire rescue and emergency rescue challenges
• Civilian rescue and first responder objectives
• Fight fire and control spreading flames
• Axe-based obstacle interactions
• Fire, smoke, sound, and visual effects
• Rescue simulator and action simulator gameplay

I Am Fire Fighter is made for players who enjoy fire fighter games, firefighter games, firefighting games, fire rescue games, emergency games, rescue games, fire fighter simulator games, and action simulation.

Hear the fire alarm, grab your fire fighter gear, fight the fire, rescue civilians, and prove your skills as a fire fighter simulator.
